name: sh.nophi/nophish
title: nophi.sh
description: Phishing-awareness for SMBs at €1 per person: public facts, and account tools with an API key.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description:
Summary of nophi.sh, a phishing-awareness training service for French SMBs: target audience,
        capabilities, the 5-step workflow, catalogue sizes (simulation templates per language, QR-code
        templates, courses, course themes), features not included, free trial terms and the free team quiz.
        Public facts; no account needed.

tools.name: list_simulation_templates
tools.description:
E-mail phishing simulation templates in one language: name, category, difficulty, QR-code flag,
        titles of the red flags employees learn to spot, and the course assigned to repeat clickers.
        Metadata only (no e-mail bodies, no links). Optional filters: category, difficulty. Paginated:
        limit (1-100, default 20) and offset; the result includes total and next_offset.

language.description: Catalogue AND answer language: 'fr' lists the French templates (what French-speaking employees receive), 'en' the English ones.
language.title: Language

category.description: Category key (as listed by get_template_categories); omitted: all categories.
category.title: Category

offset.description: Number of results to skip (next_offset of the previous page).
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: get_template_categories
tools.description:
Categories of phishing simulation templates: key, label, template counts per language and per
        difficulty, and the course assigned to repeat clickers; also the total and QR-code template counts.
        The category keys are the values accepted by the category filter of list_simulation_templates.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description:
Security-awareness course catalogue grouped by theme (essentials, fraud and money, attack channels,
        everyday habits, industry): per course the title, description, number of lessons, duration in minutes,
        quiz questions and passing score; also how courses are assigned after a click, and the practice
        exercise. Optional filter: theme.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Pricing in EUR excluding VAT: one price per person per month, the minimum billed, monthly billing
        without commitment, what is billed and included, worked examples by company size, invoice payment on
        request, and the free trial terms (14 days, no card) with the signup link.

tools.name: get_security_and_data
tools.description:
Security questionnaire answers with their date: hosting (France), backups, subprocessors (name,
        country, purpose), encryption in transit and at rest, passwords on simulated login pages (not
        collected), employee data processed, retention periods, exports. Topics outside this list are not
        covered by this server; the answer includes the contact address for them.

tools.name: get_deliverability_prerequisites
tools.description:
Mail-system configuration needed for simulation e-mails to reach inboxes, per provider:
        Microsoft 365 (Advanced Delivery, with the sending IPs and domains), Google Workspace and OVH (guidance
        on request); plus the option of sending from the company's own domain or mailbox. Optional filter:
        mail_provider.

mail_provider.description: The company's mail system; omitted: all providers.
mail_provider.title: Mail Provider

tools.name: compare_fit
tools.description:
Fit check for one company. Inputs, all optional: company size, mail provider, up to 20 needs.
        Returns the monthly price for the size (per person, minimum applied), the mail prerequisites for
        the provider, and a status per need: covered, not_covered (SMS, phone/vishing, attachment and
        ransomware-encryption simulations, with the related training), see_facts, or unknown (no public fact;
        contact address given); plus the known gaps and the trial link.

needs.description: Up to 20 needs, as keys (sms_phishing_simulation, phone_vishing_simulation, attachment_simulation, ransomware_simulation, public_api, qr_code_phishing_simulation, data_protection, hosting_in_france, reports_and_exports, report_button_with_ai_verdict, risk_scoring, practice_exercise, debrief_after_click, fraud_scenarios, french_language, english_language, security_awareness_training, email_phishing_simulation) or short free text, e.g. 'SMS phishing', 'CEO fraud', 'GDPR'.
needs.title: Needs

tools.name: start_trial_link
tools.description:
Signup URL of the 14-day free trial (no card) and the steps a person completes: sign up and verify
        their e-mail address; simulations can only target their own company's e-mail domain. Returns a link
        only: creates no account and sends no e-mail.
